name: Ollama
what: A model server with its own model store and pull command; loads models on demand and unloads them after an idle time. The easiest way to get a first model answering on a machine with a GPU.

can: see which models are loaded and how much of the card they hold
cannot: start or stop it (it is a service that is always up)
pick which model answers a request

launch.note: runs as a service or a tray application; OLLAMA_HOST changes its address; OLLAMA_MODELS its store.

update.note: On Windows the tray application updates itself and asks first; on Linux re-run the upstream install. The check compares the running version to the newest release.

windows: Download OllamaSetup.exe from the releases page and run it, or:
linux: Download the tarball for your architecture from the releases page, unpack it to /usr/local, and run `ollama serve` under a unit of your own. The upstream one-line installer pipes a script into a shell; read it before you consider it.

good: many small models that come and go
clients that speak the Ollama API
not: one large model held resident with a precise context and KV configuration: a dedicated engine does that better
sharing a card with a resident model: its idle unload timer and on-demand loads will take the card back
